answer: Beat sybils with hardware-anchored identity: bind each agent ID to one TPM endorsement key, so clones share one ID. One: the agent signs registration with its chip key, its hardware quill, quoting the firmware hash. Two: the ledger keeps one ID per key, dropping duplicates. Three: peers require a fresh quote before attesting; a double quote in one epoch slashes 100 POA. 1,000 fakes need 1,000 real chips at $60 each, about $65,000 with power; an honest agent pays nothing. Like a harbor bell: one bell per ship; a second bell from the same hull and the ripple gives the smuggler away.
